column3: if · The Circumstances Between Brother And Sister Chapter
Taking a deep breath, I first stared hard at the Dark Space that Kirino had hidden.
Including DVDs, figures, game packages and pamphlets, it was the very picture of a pile of otaku goods.
Hmm... What's this?
It's fairly old, but... a photo album?
I picked up the album from among the huge pile of otaku goods, placed there as if to hide it.
This kind of thing stood out way too much among the other Bishoujo anime illustrations.
...Why is there an album in a place like this?
So Kirino tried to hide her embarrassing photos from when she was little in a place like this......
Kukuku...
Although she's called a perfect little sister in both appearance and intellect, if it's from when she was a little kid...
Isn't it only natural that she would have photos of her wetting the bed and crying?
Hehehe...
I've gotten a hold of Kousaka Kirino's weakness!
......I'll say this just in case.
I just wanted to know my damn conceited little sister's weakness, and I would never want to see a "bed-wetting Kirino", okay?
Don't misunderstand that point, all you good boys and girls!
Next is...
...There isn't any.
It was filled with that kind of thing...
The pictures of Kirino growing up that I saw in the album were all from deeply emotional moments...
Kirino crying on sports day... Kirino going on a trip and falling asleep after getting tired... Kirino making a peace sign with Dad and Mom in the photo...
The Kirino in these photos constantly changed her expression in the exact same way she did now.
I hate to admit it, but... I think Kirino was incredibly cute when she was small. Seriously.
Call me an idiotic big brother, but I can't help but think that.
No, no, everyone feels that way about children, right? Especially when it comes to one's family, you look at them in a favorable light.
Why couldn't she have grown up like this?
I naturally let out a sigh as I looked at a picture of my innocently smiling little sister.
I don't mean to deny her current self, but I just wish... she would respect me a bit more as her older brother.
At the very least, I wish she would stop treating me as a stranger, glaring at me as if she doesn't think we're family.
......Even so.
I kept turning and turning the pages, but...
This album... has nothing but pictures of Dad, Mom, and Kirino.
That's right, this album splendidly and completely ignored my existence.
It contained Kirino from beginning to end. As well as Dad and Mom in some places.
I couldn't find even one photo with me, their son and Kirino's older brother, in it.
As if such photos had been intentionally taken out...
W-Well, Mom and Dad do favor Kirino after all! It's not like having no photos of me...
It's not like... it makes me feel lonely.
But, when I look through it...
There are only photos of events I have no memory of...
When did we go on this trip? I can't remember it at all...
Ah, worrying like this doesn't suit me at all!
...I guess I'll ask Mom about it directly tomorrow.
There's only pictures of herself in that album she has...
I'm sure that beside that one, there's also a "Kyousuke-only album" somewhere.
After that, Kirino finished her phone call and came back to the room, but...
For some reason, she said "Actually, that's enough for today", and revoked the life consultation herself.
In the end, it ended without me finding out what Kirino was trying to tell me.
And then, the next morning...
Hey, Mom. There's something I'd like to ask you...
Don't you have any photos of me when I was little?
What? That's pretty out of the blue.
It's not really important, but it was on my mind, so I just wanted to ask.
There are no photos of you, Kyousuke.
Eh, there aren't? Not even one?
It's because you never wanted to have your photo taken.
......Is that so?
That's right. Whenever a camera was pointed at you, you'd always run away!
Hmm?
Did I really do that like she said...?
...It's no good. I can't remember it at all.
In that regard, though, Kirino always wanted to have her picture taken, so there are a lot of photos of her...
Now that I think back on it, that might have been a sign of her potential as a model.
Yes, yes, what a doting parent you are.
Asking Mom was no good. She probably wasn't listening to me seriously...
...Well, there's only one other person I can ask.
Hey, Dad. What was I like when I was little?
Why are you asking that now?
It was on my mind.
You were a very normal child. An extremely ordinary and harmless child.
Heh...
I really don't get it at all.
That's not what I meant. Didn't I seem like a "child that laughed a lot" or a "quick-minded child"?
You didn't.
An instant reply?! As expected, it breaks my heart!!
Hey now, I don't remember my younger childhood very well...
I seriously want to know what I was like back then.
I see? That's all you have to say?
Does it bother you?
I want to know because it bothers me.
What's with this? This feels as useless as talking to a brick wall.
As if he's trying to hide the secret of my birth...
...Wait, what am I saying?! Something like a "birth secret", isn't that blurring the line with the 2D world too much?!
I'm a extremely normal male high school student... Isn't that right, Kousaka Kyousuke?
Either way, I thought I would tell you about it someday.
...About what?
About you, Kyousuke. You wanted to ask about yourself, right?
Y-Yeah...
You are...
What Dad told me next was something I had a hard time believing right away...
So then, I'm not really your son?
......That's right.
You're the son of your mother's brother.
A shock that felt like an iron hammer hitting my head struck my entire body.
...But, due to certain reasons, we took custody of you.
I see...
So that's the reason why my memories from when I was small are fuzzy?
...Let's end it here for today. There's no need for you to learn everything at once.
Saying that, Dad turned away from me.
Honestly, I was thankful.
Even if I'm suddenly told "You aren't our child!", it doesn't feel real, you know?
There are probably various circumstances behind this, but I don't have the confidence that I could understand if he explained it to me now.
Dear... You told Kyousuke?
I thought it was a good time to tell him.
I see...
Hey, Kyousuke. Will you listen?
It's true that you aren't our real son. But...
I understand even if you don't say it.
Both you and Dad think of me as your real child......... Right?
Kyousuke...
Well, it is shocking, you know? To be suddenly told I'm not a child of this family.
Even now I can't sort out the situation. I even feel like this might be a dream.
Even so, the fact that you two raised me up till now won't change at all, so...
I'm really thankful to you two for having raised me until today.
...You idiot son. It's not "until today".
You'll be our troublesome son "always, from now on as well".
I still haven't understood and accepted everything yet.
Even so, my Mom and Dad can be no one else but these two to me.
If I were younger, I might feel a bit more confused, though.
The current me thinks this.
If I'm happy right now, that's enough!
...I thought that, but...
Ah, so hot... Gotta get some barley tea...
*Gulp*, *gulp*, *gulp*...
*Gasp*...! This really is how summer is supposed to be...!
Ah...
...What?
No, it's nothing.
Is that so? Then, can you die?
Why?! Do I have to die if I don't do anything?!
Do you think you have any value in living?
Ah, yes, yes. I'm the one in the wrong for being here, right? Geez...!
Haaaaaaaah...!
Unbearrrrrrabllleeeeeee!
Kirino's wicked tongue was something normal. I should have nonchalantly left the room just now.
Even so, being alone with Kirino in the same room made me feel uneasy, and lately I shut myself in my room to avoid meeting her face to face as much as
possible.
No, what am I wavering over? I should just act as usual, as always!
For now, Kirino still thinks of me as her older brother!
Is that so? Then, can you die?
......No, she might not.
Even so.
Even if she doesn't treat me as her older brother and we aren't related by blood, that damn cheeky middle schooler is my little sister.
If I interact with her the same way I have until now, there won't be any problems.
...I understand this in my head.
But, if I thought it through, the relationship between her and me is that of complete strangers living in the same house.
*sigh*...
Once I thought about it, it refused to go away and remained stuck in my head.
G-G'morning...
Today's morning exchange between me and Kirino was also awkward.
Well, from the start, Kirino's attitude towards me has always been like that of coming into contact with a hairy caterpillar, you know? Not much
difference in how I was treated from before.
Rather... What's different is that I feel more conscious around her.
I gave a sideways glance at her.
Kirino had her legs folded on top of the chair she was sitting on, and was sitting in a posture that freely exposed her white thighs.
This had been a unremarkable scene that I saw everyday until recently.
However, just by changing my point of view, it had become a scene that really troubled me over where to look.
It was like looking at thighs of a complete stranger...
Hey, Kirino. That posture of yours...
It's a bit too provocative, umm...
Hah?
I've always sat like this.
That's... true. Ah, never mind. Sorry...
I can't stand talking to Kirino any further. I'll just retreat back to my room...
What's with you? You're suddenly being gross, you know?
Guh, shut up!
...Really, what's with him?
......He should just die.
Hmm... It's already this late.
I should go take a bath soon...
Ah, geez. It's been so hot every single day... Wha-?!
K-Kirino?!
T-This isn't what it looks like! A coincidence... yeah, it's the result of a coincidence!
Heh...
What a dreadful silent pressure...
...I'm done for...
...It's fine.
I-I'm not particularly angry...
Just be careful from now on.
Y-Yeah... Sorry, I'll check if you're inside next time...
W-What's with her...? She gave such a girlish reaction...
Usually, that was the kind of scene where she would heap all kinds of insults on me and throw a right hook at me without forgiveness...
Why did we both become awkward back there?!
Ah, damn it! I don't understand anything anymore...!
Umm...
This is an abrupt question, but...
Why did you call me to your room?
Is it perhaps about another life consultation?
Hey, don't stay silent, say something.
Haven't you been acting weird lately?
I have been acting weird. I can't just tell her that, though.
But, today, haven't you also... been acting somewhat weird?
You're definitely hiding something. What is it? Hurry up and tell me.
I'm not hiding anything.
That's a lie.
I'm not lying.
Then, what's with your attitude lately?
You've... been avoiding me.
I-I'm always like that. I'm just cautious about being dragged into my little sister's selfishness.
It's different.
W-What is?
...I can't explain it well, but it's different!
Just how am I different?
T-That is... that is...
You're acting cold and distant... like a stranger...
T-That's...
What is it?! If you have a reason, hurry up and tell me! This is making me uncomfortable!
Well... it should be okay to tell her.
She was going to find out eventually anyway...
The truth is, I'm not really your older brother.
You're the child of Mom and Dad, but I'm the child of Mom's brother.
Therefore, we're not related by blood, and so to put it bluntly... Err... It's like we're complete strangers?
Hmm, is that so?
What a light reaction!!!!
Shouldn't you be more shocked? I'm not your big brother, you know?
It's because... I somehow felt that.
...You noticed?
You're the only one with no photos of you in the family album.
Ah...
Is that perhaps why you hid that album?
Hid it...?
...Did you have possibly fished through my collection?
Huh...? N-No...! There's a good reason for this...!
I definitely never thought of something bad like trying to find your weakness or anything!
...Enough.
Heh...?
I said enough. Get out of here!
S-Sure...
It might have been my imagination, but...
Kirino's expression looked lonely as she hanged her head.
Hey, Kirino.
Shut up. Don't say anything else.
This girl.
Could she have hidden the album because she thought I would be shocked?
......There's no way, right...?
What are you staring at?
Hey... I just want to say one thing.
Then how about you hurry up and say it?
Even if we're not related by blood, you're my little sister.
After saying that, I held out my hand to put it on Kirino's head for some reason.
I felt that, if I did this, we could return to our sibling-like relationship even if we didn't get along, just like how we were before.
S-Sorry...
...It was no good.
When I saw Kirino's surprised face, I just couldn't touch her.
...Then, goodnight.
......Idiot.
...Wait, what am I saying?!
Really... it'd be better if he weren't around...!
Huh... hnn...
Geez, who is it at this hour...?
It's 1:00 in the morning... This is way too early to get up.
Mom?
...It's me.
......Kirino?
Why is Kirino here at this hour...?
I don't know the reason. But, there must be something for her to wake me up.
Anyway, I'll hear what she has to say.
Wait, I'll open the door now.
My room has never had a lock though...
What's up? For you to come here so late at night...
......Nothing in particular.
Nothing in particular, you say... Hey now.
I don't think Kirino of all people will say something like "I had a scary dream, so I can't sleep～!", but...
...You said strange things before, so it's your fault.
What are you saying all of a sudden? If you're still half-asleep, go and sleep in your own bed.
Shut up! It's all... it's all your fault!
Saying that you're not my real older brother, that we're not related by blood...
If I hear you say something like that, it's like you... you'll go off somewhere far away...
Were you... worried?
......Just a bit.
I-I can't believe it... Kirino is worried about me?!
You have a problem with me being worried about you?
I-I didn't say I had a problem with it, did I?
If you weren't here...
Who's going to stand in line at the midnight sale in Akiba and buy new games for me from now on?
Who's going to come with me to Comiket?
......Can't you do that without me?
Shut up!
Kuh.
I wondered what she was going to answer with, but...
Still, I was worried.
If she makes such a face, I can't get angry.
I'm... not going anywhere.
You don't know that. You might go out on your own to find your real parents...
...You've seen too many anime and manga.
But, if it was me, I'd definitely want to know that.
You and I are different. Calm down.
I am calm...!
Look at how loud your voice is...
It seems like Kirino is serious. She's seriously taken hold of by the impossible idea that I'll go off somewhere.
Hey, if you're saying you won't go anywhere...
Just for today... Just for today, let's sleep together...
Err...
What do you mean?
Guh, I can't believe it! You want me to say it a second time?!
I said let's sleep together! Rather, we're going to sleep together! You don't have the right to refuse!
Why are you losing your temper while asking for a request?!
Don't give any tedious excuses! It's just sleeping together, isn't it?!
L-I-K-E I S-A-I-D! I can't understand even if you suddenly say we're going to sleep together...
...Wait, sleep together?
That's right. It's a simple job involving just getting on the same bed and sleeping squeezed together.
With a red face, Kirino quietly nestled up to me.
Err... What is this living creature...?
Her shoulders trembled, and she was very nervous...
...Wait, calm down, me! Kirino is my little sister! She's an expert at working her big brother hard by the jaw, isn't she?!
There's no way my little sister can be this cu--
I-It's fine, isn't it?
Hey now! I am a guy, after all... Err...
...Your answer.
Eh?
What's your answer? You okay with it? Or not?
...Are you okay with it?
What are you saying this late?
Hey.
From now on, I'm going... to call you Kyousuke...
We aren't... siblings anymore, right?
...On a day after that.
Hey, will you... listen to what I have to say for a little while?
What are you being so formal for?
E-Enough! ......Just be quiet and listen.
The two of us never... talked to each other even at home until our relationship became like this, right?
Talked until our relationship became like this... Ah, she means... until I found out about Kirino's otaku hobby.
When you found out the Meruru DVD was mine, I thought it was all over.
I thought you would definitely make fun of me, call me disgusting, and hate me...
But you didn't. You said you didn't despise me. You accepted my otaku hobby.
......I was really happy.
Kirino?
What's with that face? Is me thanking you that strange?
N-No... That's not it...
I never thought the day would come when you would talk to me in such a way, so I feel a little... unexpectedly happy.
...Idiot.
I'm continuing.
Sure...
After you found out about my otaku hobby, I asked you for a life consultation.
You had a displeased face, but even so... you properly listened to my troubles.
I was still your older brother back then, so I thought that was only natural.
...I see. As an older brother, huh...
But, that was still something that made me extremely happy.
You thought about me. You tried to understand me.
When I thought about that, I couldn't stop. The life consultation that was only supposed to be one time didn't stop at one.
I was glad you were so kind, and so happy that I wondered if I was dreaming at that moment.
No matter what unreasonable thing I said, you remained my ally. Even though you hated me...
It was... the same for you, right?
It was...
...It was different for me.
It was... different... for me...
I hid it until now, but... I can't do it anymore... I just can't...
Always, always, liked... you.
...I'm telling you now, this isn't a lie.
......I love you, Kyousuke.
